# Resource: stripe_shipping_rate

What Checkout charges for shipping. `terraform destroy` archives the shipping rate, because Stripe cannot delete one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "stripe_shipping_rate" "ground" {
  display_name = "Ground shipping"
  tax_behavior = "exclusive"

  fixed_amount = {
    amount   = 500
    currency = "usd"
  }

  delivery_estimate = {
    minimum = { unit = "business_day", value = 3 }
    maximum = { unit = "business_day", value = 5 }
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are required:

* `display_name` - (Required) The name of the shipping rate, meant to be displayable to the customer. This will appear on CheckoutSessions. Changing it replaces the resource.

The following arguments are optional:

* `active` - (Optional) Whether the shipping rate can be used for new purchases. Defaults to `true`.
* `delivery_estimate` - (Optional) The estimated range for how long shipping will take, meant to be displayable to the customer. This will appear on CheckoutSessions. Changing it replaces the resource. See [`delivery_estimate`](#delivery_estimate) below.
* `fixed_amount` - (Optional) Describes a fixed amount to charge for shipping. Must be present if type is `fixed_amount`. See [`fixed_amount`](#fixed_amount) below.
* `metadata` - (Optional) Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value to them. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to `metadata`.
* `tax_behavior` - (Optional) Specifies whether the rate is considered inclusive of taxes or exclusive of taxes. One of `inclusive`, `exclusive`, or `unspecified`. Possible values: `exclusive`, `inclusive`, `unspecified`.
* `tax_code` - (Optional) A [tax code](https://docs.stripe.com/tax/tax-categories) ID. The Shipping tax code is `txcd_92010001`. Changing it replaces the resource.
* `type` - (Optional) The type of calculation to use on the shipping rate. Possible values: `fixed_amount`. Changing it replaces the resource.

<a id="delivery_estimate"></a>
### `delivery_estimate`

The `delivery_estimate` attribute supports:

* `maximum` - (Optional) The upper bound of the estimated range. If empty, represents no upper bound i.e., infinite. See [`delivery_estimate.maximum`](#delivery_estimate.maximum) below.
* `minimum` - (Optional) The lower bound of the estimated range. If empty, represents no lower bound. See [`delivery_estimate.minimum`](#delivery_estimate.minimum) below.

<a id="delivery_estimate.maximum"></a>
### `delivery_estimate.maximum`

The `delivery_estimate.maximum` attribute supports:

* `unit` - (Required) A unit of time. Possible values: `business_day`, `day`, `hour`, `month`, `week`.
* `value` - (Required) Must be greater than 0.

<a id="delivery_estimate.minimum"></a>
### `delivery_estimate.minimum`

The `delivery_estimate.minimum` attribute supports:

* `unit` - (Required) A unit of time. Possible values: `business_day`, `day`, `hour`, `month`, `week`.
* `value` - (Required) Must be greater than 0.

<a id="fixed_amount"></a>
### `fixed_amount`

The `fixed_amount` attribute supports:

* `amount` - (Required) A non-negative integer in cents representing how much to charge. Changing it replaces the resource.
* `currency` - (Required) Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies). Changing it replaces the resource.
* `currency_options` - (Optional) Shipping rates defined in each available currency option. Each key must be a three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html) and a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies). See [`fixed_amount.currency_options`](#fixed_amount.currency_options) below.

<a id="fixed_amount.currency_options"></a>
### `fixed_amount.currency_options`

The `fixed_amount.currency_options` attribute is a map. Each value supports:

* `amount` - (Required) A non-negative integer in cents representing how much to charge.
* `tax_behavior` - (Optional) Specifies whether the rate is considered inclusive of taxes or exclusive of taxes. One of `inclusive`, `exclusive`, or `unspecified`. Possible values: `exclusive`, `inclusive`, `unspecified`.

## Attribute Reference

This resource exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `id` - Unique identifier for the object.
* `created` - Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
* `livemode` - If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.

## Timeouts

[Configuration options](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/syntax#operation-timeouts) are set with the `timeouts` attribute, for example `timeouts = { create = "5m" }`:

* `create` - (Default `20m`)
* `delete` - (Default `20m`)
* `update` - (Default `20m`)

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, and in OpenTofu, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import a shipping rate using its ID. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = stripe_shipping_rate.ground
  id = "shr_123"
}
```

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, and in OpenTofu v1.12.0 and later, the `import` block can use the `identity` attribute instead. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = stripe_shipping_rate.ground
  identity = {
    id = "shr_123"
  }
}
```

### Identity Schema

#### Required

* `id` (String) The Stripe ID of the shipping rate.

Using `terraform import`, import a shipping rate using its ID. For example:

```console
% terraform import stripe_shipping_rate.ground shr_123
```
